test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

He likes people to flatter him.

options.text: He likes to be flattered by people.
He likes to have been flattered by people.
He likes people to be flattered by him.
He liked to be flattered by people.

solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'He likes to be flattered by people.'
